1879060437.name: Threatening Shout
1879060437.desc: A shout that draws threat, forcing the enemy to attack you.

1879089621.name: Lesser Persistence
1879089621.desc: Large increase to armour for a short time.

1879136213.name: Call the Shadow
1879136213.desc: You call upon the Shadow to bolster your attacks against your target.

1879138645.name: Efflorescence
1879138645.desc: Living slime relieves the sting of wounds on the flesh of your allies in your fellowship.

1879213909.name: First Blood (Melee)
1879213909.desc: Your fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879218261.name: Imp. Penetrating Shot: Burn Through
1879218261.desc: A damaging shot that pierces enemy mitigations.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879241429.name: Improved Gift of the Hammerhand
1879241429.desc: Grants a bubble to multiple Fellowship members.\n\nBubble strength is 20% of the targets' Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879243989.name: Rider and Steed
1879243989.desc: You forge a stronger bond between you and your steed. Surrounding allies also form a stronger bond with their steed.

1879255893.name: Launch a Yellow Firework
1879255893.desc: Launches a bright yellow firework for the Bree festival show.

1879270613.name: Lightning Strike
1879270613.desc: Calls lightning to strike the enemy, dealing heavy damage.\n\n<rgb=#ff0091>With Improved Ignition, this skill can cash-out Burning Embers for bonus damage.</rgb>

1879302613.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Squire)
1879302613.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879315029.name: Bash
1879315029.desc: A savage attack that leaves your target bleeding.

1879316053.name: Execute
1879316053.desc: Consume remaining Wrath to deal a massive amount of damage. Can not miss or be blocked, parried, or evaded. \n \n Damage is increased by 20% for every 20 Wrath you consume.

1879329365.name: Blue Beetle
1879329365.desc: Summons a beetle to keep you company.

1879339349.name: Storm-wing Kite
1879339349.desc: Brings out a storm-wing kite for you to fly!

1879344469.name: Friendly Deer
1879344469.desc: A friendly deer will keep you company.

1879352149.name: Sunflower Steed
1879352149.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879362261.name: Snow Owl
1879362261.desc: Brings out a snow owl to keep you company.

1879391445.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Swordswoman)
1879391445.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879404501.name: Bat Whirl
1879404501.desc: Apparently you have startled a colony of bats into swirling flight.

1879406805.name: Mysterious Celebration Pig
1879406805.desc: Brings out a wise and friendly pig definitely on party business.

1879421653.name: Fear No Darkness
1879421653.desc: Your companion is stalwart in the face of great evils, encouraging you and your fellowship to stand fast against the enemy.\nCleanses ill effects and restores Morale.

1879484373.name: Punishing Blow
1879484373.desc: A powerful attack that can only be used on opponents under 20% health.

1879486037.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Dune-stalker Caracal)
1879486037.desc: Summons a lynx-type companion.\n\nThe caracal is a stealthy hunter.

1879492181.name: Roaring Shield
1879492181.desc: Your shield is a bulwark against the barbarians of the south. With a powerful strike, you can demoralize your foes and restore your Morale.

1879497685.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497685.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879507669.name: Torturer's Brand
1879507669.desc: Use the Torturer's Brand to cauterize the target's Grisly Wounds.

1879528277.name: Prepared: Wisp of Shadow
1879528277.desc: Servants of the Umbral Pall use wisps of shadow to harm their enemies.
